question: When may a style observed on one source component be applied to a different target component family or state?
procedure: Record the source component family, semantic role, state and computed visual evidence.
Record the target host component family, semantic role and state independently.
Require same-role evidence or an explicit approved policy before promoting color, edge, shadow, radius or motion across component families.
When same-role evidence is absent, mark the target family unmapped and choose a declared fallback: neutral visual, justified existing visual or omission.
Do not use brand frequency, visual similarity or a generic label such as primary as a substitute for role evidence.
Verify the rendered target state and reject semantic leakage even when the result looks brand-colored.
notFor: Copying login-action color into tabs or filters without same-role proof
Treating repeated color as universal interaction semantics
Using aesthetic preference to override business status color
readerPurpose: 阻止颜色和状态样式在不同组件职责间无证据串用
